chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from an-Nadr from Yahya al-Halabi from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar from Abu Basir said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Do I pray (send blessings) upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) while I am in prostration?' He said, 'Yes, it is like saying Subhanallah and Allahu Akbar.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to send blessings upon the Prophet while in prostration during prayer?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the permissibility of reciting *Salat al-Nabi* while in *sujood*, equating its spiritual merit to the fundamental dhikr of 'Subhanallah' and 'Allahu Akbar'. This ruling highlights the flexibility within Shia jurisprudence regarding voluntary acts of worship during the bowing and prostration positions, distinguishing them from obligatory recitations. It underscores the high status of sending blessings upon the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt as a continuous act of devotion integrated into the prayer structure.
